# TODO — queued by relay-watch triage

## Why this is queued, not executed
relay-watch only reads/writes `.handoffs/*` and cannot run destructive/secrets-adjacent ops (volume wipes, DB row deletes, PR merges against production infra). These need GM sign-off first — see the paired escalation `20260901T085300Z__ccr__gm-phone`.

## Source leg
`20260901T084647Z__claude-app__g-whoentertains` — "P1 Space-sqlite grid: triage complete, 2 root causes found; 3 gated commands await GM". Read that leg for full findings.

## Root causes found (blade1tb triage, already done)
1. Space volume corruption: SQLite WAL journaling on network-backed `/data` degrades under write load (DBs 1,2,4,6,7,9 malformed). A restart alone does not clear it.
2. Federation self-loop: blade's `cloud_nodes` table has exactly one row pointing `shards-nougenai-fleet` back at blade's own public URL, so `federated_retrieve` recurses into itself until timeout — this, not the Space corruption, explains empty connector recall (e.g. ChatGPT's April-shards gap).

## The 3 gated commands, once GM approves
1. `gh pr merge 169 --squash` (sync-guard: survives malformed DBs, adds `X-NGS-Degraded-DBs` header + `databases_skipped` field, CI already green)
2. `tools/wipe_space_volume.py` — wipe + restart the Space volume
3. DELETE the self-loop row from `cloud_nodes` (instant, no restart needed)
4. After the wipe: `tools/relay_push.py --missing-only` — clean refill from blade (235,086 shards, 9/9 healthy)

## Follow-ups also flagged by the source leg (separate work, not gated)
- Add a federation loop guard (identity check, not URL string compare) plus a `node unlink` CLI action.
- `recall_trustworthy = complete OR bool(upstreams)` launders a self-looped upstream as trustworthy — same bug class as a previously-fixed DB8 issue; needs its own fix once the self-loop row is gone.

## Done when
All 3 gated commands have run in order (merge -> wipe -> delete self-loop row -> refill), `shards_coverage` shows 9/9 healthy DBs on the Space, and a live connector recall test (e.g. re-running the April 2026 query) returns real data instead of a false empty.
